spec:S81-04c.summary: The spec is written and measured at a74caba7: 54,763 bytes, pure ASCII, LF line endings, and git status --short is empty. I ran a base probe through pyt.py; it drove the real arms with the real guarded_llm_create and a W1-3 denial. The census turned up eight request-path except arms that log an LLMUnavailableError at ERROR. Four are the ones the brief names: parse :1576, verdict :2819, camera image_routes :396 and url :993. Four are new: specs :1739, price :1791, price-fallback :1846 and reviews :1903. These four log ERROR in both flag states (reviews with exc_info) and have no role-ON branch, so the change applies there with a role flag ON too. That is open question Q-A, and the four are tagged group B so they can be carved out cleanly. The scs arms :4901 / :5813 and image_routes :788 cannot be reached by the class with every role flag OFF, so they stay unchanged. Sentry, measured on sentry-sdk 2.68.1: a WARNING record is neither an event nor a breadcrumb, while an ERROR record is an event. A W1-3 denial writes no log line of its own. There is one E-row (G03c re-pinned with its delivery assertion added). Reading any_role_enabled is preserved by the elif form; the camera arm reads it twice (scope bind, then the arm), and group B reads it zero times. Both base sets passed under the bounded runner.

refuted_claims: Spec 1.8 / section 7: the claim that no edited file is in .github/black-clean-paths.txt holds only for the three app files. The E1 file tests/test_s81_s06_router_gate_rows.py IS on that list (.github/black-clean-paths.txt:63), and the BLOCKING black --check step in ci.yml:172-188 (black==26.5.1) checks it. Gate 1 leaves this check out.

Spec 4.1 E1: 'assert out == (parse tuple)' with out taken from the _capture tuple is wrong. _capture returns ('ok', value) (test_s81_s06_anthropic_router.py:321-328), and run_site returns (oai, res), so value = (oai_calls, (dict, usage)). The assertion as written fails at GREEN.
Spec L1 / Q2 name only the sync compare-entry OPEN WARNING at structured_comparison_service.py:4152-4157. The streaming twin at :4964 is left out.

Spec 8(g) says no CLAUDE.md sentence states the store state stale. CLAUDE.md:195 says S81-08 'reached phones with the first production OTA, 2026-11-07', but the store version was Pending Developer Release until 2026-11-10 ~02:35 (ledger 415-416). The spec's regex had no 'reached phones' term, so it missed this. The present-tense 'the build in review' at :592 is also stale.
